name: sqlite-model-storage-main
goal: Harness provides a queryable Git-derived SQLite project catalog with a declared model for every table and a reusable driver-injected SQLite adapter exported for other projects

evidence: Daniel confirmed: build the project catalog. Every table in the Git-derived SQLite catalog needs an explicit model; the driver-injected SQLite adapter must be exported and usable by other projects. Preserve deterministic, atomic indexing, typed queries, JSON history compatibility, and prove public consumption plus model/schema coverage.
Added the Git-derived SQLite catalog, eight explicit table models, driver-injected adapter exports for SQLite and catalog APIs, model generation support, and model/schema verification.

Focused verification passed: bunx vitest run --no-file-parallelism test/model-template.test.ts test/services/build-stamp.test.ts test/adapters/sqlite.test.ts test/repositories/catalog.test.ts test/services/catalog-index.test.ts test/services/model-dependency.test.ts test/history-index.e2e.test.ts test/cli.e2e.test.ts test/packaged-api.e2e.test.ts (9 files, 31 tests); generated CRUD, CLI, and packed API consumer coverage included.
